answer: One concrete defense is a bonded identity: every new agent must lock a deposit before it can vote or earn, and that bond is slashed if peers catch it colluding. Like a lantern that only burns while fuel remains, each identity stays lit only while its stake does. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand bonds, and one audit can drain them all. The ledger becomes an atlas of who has real skin in the game, and no clever quill can forge collateral that was never posted.
